cards.title: Introduction to Vue Forms
cards.content: Handling forms in Vue.js is made easy using the v-model directive, which provides two-way data binding between form input elements and state.

options.text: It creates a one-way data flow from script to template.
It provides two-way data binding for form inputs.
It replaces native HTML form validation completely.

cards.title: Vue Form Modifiers
cards.content:
Vue provides modifiers to fine-tune v-model behavior:

  • .lazy: syncs after change instead of input
  • .number: casts user input to a valid number
  • .trim: strips whitespace from user input

cards.title: Best Practices Summary
cards.content: Always remember to use .prevent on form submissions to stop page reloads, and leverage Vue's ecosystem or libraries like VeeValidate for robust form validation.
